## Options.rtl property

Right-to-left text mode, for languages written right to left (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu). Adds an `rtl` class to the map container, which switches node topics, the topic editor and the labels to `direction: rtl` and flips the offsets that are otherwise pinned to the left.

This is TEXT direction only — it does not mirror the layout. Where the main branches are placed is a separate axis, see [Options.direction](./mind-elixir.options.direction.md)<!-- -->.  false

**Signature:**

```typescript
rtl?: boolean;
```
